title: Entrypoint and seed paths are untested (0% coverage)
evidence: go test ./... -cover: cmd/wombat-mcp coverage 0.0%, internal/seed 0.0%; no test drives run()/backgroundSync or seed.LoadFile
suggestion: Add a smoke test that opens a temp cache, seeds knowledge-graph.json, and asserts the store is populated

title: Sync engine coverage is moderate (60.9%)
evidence: go test ./internal/syncengine -cover: 60.9% of statements; error branches of Sync (non-200, unmarshal failure) exercised less than the happy path

title: Durable cache is a single JSON file rather than an embedded DB
evidence: internal/graph/graph.go: Store persists {entities,relationships,watermark} via MarshalIndent + atomic temp-file rename
suggestion: Acceptable per R6 ('embedded DB or equivalent'); note that whole-file rewrite on every Put may not scale to large graphs

title: Offline WOMBAT_SEED path is a thoughtful extra beyond spec
evidence: cmd/wombat-mcp/main.go reads WOMBAT_SEED and internal/seed.LoadFile seeds the cache from knowledge-graph.json when no server is available
suggestion: Enhancement beyond spec — enables running the 12 tools with no live FunkyGibbon server
